text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The price of petrol is rising in Macedonia because of the influence of the world market. The influence of the price rises on inflation will by clear by the end of the month.

- The Macedonian Parliament passed an Ecology Law. During the parliamentary session, the Association of Ecologists demonstrated in front of the building against polution and demanded the new law be implimented as soon as possible.

- The OSCE high commissioner for ethnic issues, Max Van der Stoel in Skopje chaired a round-table discussion about "inter-ethnic relations in Macedonia" behind closed doors. The opposition Macedonian and ethnic Albanian parties objected because they were not invited.
